name: The Never Ending Flower Shop
storyline:
Through Rita Consuelo, you explore an abandoned flower shop previously owned by your mother, with the task of collecting the perfect seedling of a specific flower: The Queen Of The Night.

You grew up running around this place, you should know it's layout... But the walls now extend into a mysterious Blank Space, with new rooms that seem to never end and ever-growing flowers spreading everywhere.

Now you must get to the bottom of this and find out what is happening within Floricultura Consuelo, helping the lost customers you find along the way, sneaking past mysterious entities born from the flowers and if necessary, fighting your way to get to the root of the issue: Whatever it is that your mother has done and is now up to you to fix it...
summary: The Never Ending Flower Shop is a game focused on exploration, you will fight your way through the lost Floricultura Consuelo, a place that once thrived in the ownership of your mother, now forgotten, exactly as she left it.
